name: Kickstand Kettlebell Row
description: A single-arm row from a kickstand stance — no bench, no hand on the knee. Stagger the working-arm-side foot back on its toe as a kickstand, hinge over the front leg with a flat back, and let the bell hang straight down from the shoulder. Row the bell to the hip, driving the elbow back past the ribs and squeezing the shoulder blade, then lower under control. The free arm reaches back for balance. The front leg carries the load and the trunk has to resist twisting open toward the bell, so it trains the hinge and anti-rotation as much as the pull. Start each rep from a dead stop on the floor if you want it stricter.
